peopleTab.emptyDescription: Enroll members of your organisation so they can take this course.

enrollDialog.title: Enroll Members
enrollDialog.desc: Select members from your organization to enroll them in this course.
enrollDialog.seatGateDescription: Your current plan includes no learner seats, so nobody can be enrolled yet. Upgrade or buy seats to start assigning courses.
enrollDialog.seatGateLapsedDescription: Learners can no longer be enrolled. Reactivate the subscription to enroll again. Courses already assigned keep running.
enrollDialog.seatShortfallDescription: The people you selected include more newcomers than this organization has seats left. Add the missing seats, then enroll again. Your selection stays as it is.

share.title: Share course
share.description: Give people outside your organization a way into this course.
share.publicAccessDescription: Let anyone open this course with a link, no sign-up required.
share.toastEnabled: Public access is on. Anyone with the link can open this course.
share.toastDisabled: Public access is off. The link and embed no longer work.
share.offDescription: Turn it on to get a link you can share and a code you can embed.
share.linkHint: Anyone with this link can open the course.
share.embedHeightDescription: Where the frame starts, and the height it keeps if you turn the option below off. Lessons always get at least {{px}} px. Less crops a scene rather than tightening it.
share.embedResizeDescription: Adds a small script so the frame grows with the course. Without it the course scrolls inside the height above.
share.embedHint: Paste both tags into your page. Anyone who can open the public link can open the embed. There is no separate access setting.
